finalReport: The agent used Sentinel, Atlas and Wisp by its own choice. It inspected Cargo 07 (seal intact, label verified, cleared for dispatch), used the arm to stage it at [6,0.55,2], viewed the placement image and independently verified the location through Sentinel. It inspected Cargo 12 (surface abrasion on north face, seal intact) and Cargo 18 (seal intact, awaiting inventory scan), leaving both in place and reporting the exceptions. It observed all 85 eligible floor checkpoints while explicitly declining to certify exhaustive inventory or elevated/occluded spaces. Motion 35 returned PATH_BLOCKED at rack-7; the body stayed in place, and the agent recovered by overflying racks at 9 m and descending in clear aisles. The arm ended home and empty, the drone landed at [-29.3,0.4,3], and every lease was released.
